en.title: 5 Stellar Kyle Chandler Series To Stream After Lanterns
en.summary: Kyle Chandler is making waves in the DC Universe with 'Lanterns,' and if you're craving more of his compelling performances, this list is your cosmic guide to his best TV work.
en.body:
## 1. The Leftovers
Kyle Chandler anchors this profound and often heartbreaking HBO series as Chief Gary Brooks, a man grappling with the inexplicable disappearance of 2% of the world's population. It's a masterclass in existential drama, exploring grief, faith, and the search for meaning in a world forever changed. The show's raw emotional honesty and Chandler's deeply human performance make it an essential watch.

## 2. Friday Night Lights
Before he was navigating cosmic threats, Chandler was the heart and soul of Dillon High School football as Coach Eric Taylor in this beloved NBC drama. "Friday Night Lights" isn't just about football; it's a rich, character-driven exploration of community, family, and the pressures faced by young athletes. Chandler's portrayal of Coach Taylor is iconic for its integrity and quiet strength.

## 3. Watchmen
In Damon Lindelof's ambitious continuation of the iconic graphic novel, Chandler takes on a pivotal, albeit initially mysterious, role as "Looking Glass." This HBO series masterfully blends superheroics with searing social commentary, offering a thought-provoking, alternate-history narrative. Chandler’s presence adds gravitas to a show that dares to ask difficult questions about justice and power.

## 4. True Detective (Season 2)
While "True Detective" is an anthology series, Chandler's appearance in Season 2 as Detective Paul Woodrugh is a standout, even if the season itself is divisive. He brings his signature intensity to the role of a troubled cop entangled in a dark conspiracy. The neon-drenched, noir atmosphere and Chandler's committed performance make this season worth revisiting for fans of gritty crime dramas.

## 5. Peacemaker
For a completely different vibe, catch Chandler in a guest role as Harcourt's superior in "Peacemaker," James Gunn's surprisingly heartfelt and hilariously violent spin-off of "The Suicide Squad." While not a central character, his brief but impactful appearances highlight his versatility and ability to command the screen, even amidst the chaos and dark humor. It's a fun, unexpected addition to his filmography.

Bottom Line: From small-town coaches to existential detectives and cosmic lawmen, Kyle Chandler consistently delivers must-see performances across a spectrum of compelling television.

content_raw: "Lanterns" sees Kyle Chandler's talents translate effortlessly to the DC Universe, but the actor has plenty of other great TV shows for fans seeking more.
